examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

examples.text: Я не могу дозвониться до своей жены.
examples.trans: I cannot get through to my wife.
At home I can't reach him.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'красть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to steal', paired with 'красть'.

examples.text: Чтобы он вернул деньги, которые украл.
examples.trans: For him to give back the money he stole.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

познакомиться.gloss: to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)

meanings.en: to meet for the first time, to get acquainted

examples.trans: I dreamed of meeting your friends.

examples.text: А как вы с ней познакомились?
examples.trans: And how did you meet her?

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

meanings.note: regularly, or as a general invitation: приходи!

examples.trans: If you change your mind, come back. The job is waiting.

meanings.en: to threaten, to pose a threat to

examples.text: Конфликты с соседями угрожают здоровью подсудимого.
examples.trans: Conflicts with the neighbours threaten the defendant's health.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: cruel, harsh, ruthless (short form: жесток / жестока / жестоки)
meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('cruel, harsh, severe').

examples.text: Анатолий Иванович, вы были слишком жестоки.
examples.trans: Anatoly Ivanovich, you were too harsh.
I agree, but life can be cruel.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?
